To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the radiation pattern of the antenna is influenced by the car body and that the radiation pattern is influenced by a glass roof.

the roof of the car is the most important part of the car chassis for C2C communication, that an antenna placed at the roof is able to provide a nearly omnidirectional radiation pattern, that the side mirrors and the bumper are less important and that the glass roof has a strong influence on the radiation pattern.
the antenna placement has a major impact on the radiation pattern and the antenna should be placed at the highest point of the car, i.e. on the roof.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a better understanding of the wave propagation and antenna placement for C2C communication.
a better understanding of the wave propagation and radiation patterns for various antenna positions in the context of C2C communication.
the investigation of the antenna placement and the influence of the vehicle on the radiation pattern for Car-to-Carlane communication.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a side mirror antenna is a good choice for a C2C communication system, because of its omnidirectional radiation in the horizontal plane, its small electrical size and its low sensitivity to wave guidance and diffractions.
an antenna on the roof is a good candidate, but the antenna should not be placed too high on the roof.
the side mirrors are the most suitable location to place an antenna, as the radiation pattern is almost omnidirectional in the horizontal plane.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the roof and bumpers are the most promising locations for C2C communication, since they provide the most omnidirectional coverage.

the antenna should be placed as close to the ground plane as possible to achieve a good radiation pattern in the vertical plane, and as close to the roof as possible to achieve good radiation pattern in horizontal plane.
the antenna placement is a crucial parameter for the performance of a C2C system, but it is possible to achieve omnidirectional coverage by placing the antennas on the roof or on side mirrors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a full wave analysis of the whole car chassis is not necessary to obtain reliable information about the antenna performance.
the roof is the best place for an omnidirectional antenna for Car-to-Cars communications.
the roof is the best location to place a C2C antenna.
